Chapter 930: Chapter 25: All Rules of the Great Dao Origin from Chaos (Please Subscribe)_2

But now, the Chaos Rule has condensed all the rules that Lin Yuan has comprehended into one.

Even though his life essence has not yet stepped into the twelfth layer, in terms of frontal combat power, Lin Yuan can certainly be regarded as at the ultimate level of the twelfth layer.

This is still only the true body of Lin Yuan in the Immortal Realm.

The true body in the Immortal Realm is, after all, just a temporary vessel for Lin Yuan; in terms of foundational accumulation, it is far inferior to the true self in the Main Universe.

The true self in the Main Universe has a foundation that endured the Chaos Void Origin Infusion when breaking through to the eleventh layer.

However, most of these foundations, due to Lin Yuan’s life level not meeting the standard, are submerged deep within his inner world.

However, since Lin Yuan has nurtured the Chaos Rule, even though his life level remains unchanged, his absorption of the Chaos Void Origin will certainly increase significantly.

It can be anticipated that once Lin Yuan returns, the strength of his true self in the Main Universe will definitely improve by a greater margin than his current true self in the Immortal Realm.

At that time, even if the ultimate beings at the twelfth layer in the Main Universe are somewhat stronger than the Ancestor of the Immortal Path, Lin Yuan will still be able to contend or even suppress them.

The ultimate beings of the twelfth layer in the Main Universe compete with each other, coupled with numerous inherited treasures from beyond the universe and the infusion of the Chaos Void Origin during the ultimate leap.

Their average strength far exceeds that of the Ancestor of the Immortal Path.

“Do I feel like I am going to be forced to take the ultimate leap at any moment?”

Lin Yuan let out a sigh of relief; his foundational accumulation is now so strong that even the river of time seems almost unable to restrain him.

“Hang in there, hang in there.”

Lin Yuan steeled his spirit; the ultimate leap must take place in the Main Universe.

After all, taking the ultimate leap in the Main Universe allows one to receive the Chaos Void Origin Infusion, something that is not available in the Immortal Realm. This is also one of the reasons why the strength of the Ancestor of the Immortal Path is not as great as the ultimate beings of the twelfth layer in the Main Universe.

Lin Yuan is not sure whether, after making the ultimate leap in the Immortal Realm, returning to the Main Universe’s Chaos Void would result in another round of Origin Infusion.

But to be on the safe side, it’s better to return and then attempt to ascend to the twelfth layer.

…

“Chaos Rule?”

Lin Yuan’s thoughts converged as he began to become familiar with this entirely new force, or rather, rule.

…

As Lin Yuan continuously operated the Chaos Rule and came into collision with the countless rules of the Immortal Realm, the entire operation of rules in the Immortal Realm began to tremble incessantly.

In the Primordial Lands, Dao Ancestor Continent.

The Ancestor of the Immortal Path was in secluded cultivation, and even after stepping into the twelfth layer, he still needed to comprehend many rules.

“Hmm?”

Suddenly, the Ancestor of the Immortal Path abruptly opened his eyes, revealing a trace of shock on his face.

“Why do I feel that all the rule fluctuations are trembling?” the Ancestor of the Immortal Path couldn’t believe it.

The fluctuations of the rules are orderly and stable; it is the perfect combination of countless rules that allows the world to function completely.

Especially in the eyes of a twelfth-layer being like the Ancestor of the Immortal Path, rule fluctuations seem to have their own life.

But at this moment…

The Ancestor of the Immortal Path clearly perceived that all the rule fluctuations in the Primordial Lands, to be precise, all the rule fluctuations in the Immortal Realm, were beginning to become disorderly and chaotic.

It was as if a formerly tranquil pond, where every stream of water was stable, now had a colossal being twisting deep within, causing undercurrents in the placid pond.

However, the operation of the world covered by myriad rules already forms a perfect balance; it is not something you can disturb just because you want to, even for someone as powerful as the Ancestor of the Immortal Path. Channeling his own way only allows him to affect the stability of the rules within a certain range.

The current widespread chaos of rules throughout the Immortal Realm was causing some panic in the Ancestor of the Immortal Path.

“What could be the reason?”

The Ancestor of the Immortal Path scanned the entire Primordial Lands as well the thirty-three domains of the Immortal Domain. Even far off in the Demon Abyss, the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss was similarly scrutinizing the vast Demon Abyss.

“Is it the Ancestor of Martial Arts?”

After observing for a long time, the Ancestor of the Immortal Path finally turned his gaze toward the core of the Origin of the Immortal Realm, where the consciousness of the Immortal Realm resides.

That is also where the Ancestor of Martial Arts entered a thousand years ago.

The Ancestor of the Immortal Path was uncertain what exactly was causing the current chaos of rules.

But it was definitely not related to him.

In the Immortal Realm and Demon Abyss, aside from himself, the only one capable of causing such an outcome…

Is the unreachable Ancestor of Martial Arts.

“Just what has the Ancestor of Martial Arts done to bring about this situation…”

The Ancestor of the Immortal Path felt waves of tumult in his heart. He could sense the trembling and fear of the Primordial Lands and the myriad rules of the Immortal Realm.

“Has there been a breakthrough, stepping into the Ancestral Realm?”

The Ancestor of the Immortal Path speculated in his mind, but then shook his head.

He was himself at the Ancestral Realm and knew what kind of impact stepping into the Ancestral Realm would cause. Although it was immense and unimaginable, it was definitely not what was happening now.

And up until now, the Ancestor of the Immortal Path had not sensed any life breaking free from the shackles of the river of time, which meant that the Ancestor of Martial Arts had not yet stepped into the Ancestral Realm.

…

The operation of the Chaos Rule was first felt by the Ancestor of the Immortal Path.

It was then perceived by many Golden Immortals and Jade Immortals of the thirty-three domains of the Immortal Domain.

Golden Immortals, having penetrated the Space Rules, had a certain degree of sensitivity to space-time, and even more so for Jade Immortals. In comparison, the immortals below the Golden Immortals and the many mortals felt a less evident sensation.

“What on earth is happening?”

“Why are the Space Rules beginning to destabilize?”

“I’m feeling it too, many fundamental rules are the same.”

In the thirty-three domains of the Immortal Domain, Golden Immortals and Jade Immortals looked fearful. The Ancestor of the Immortal Path had already transcended his own Dao; external changes in rules would not have much impact on him. His foundation was eternally solid, which is the essence of the Path Splitting Realm.

But what about the Golden Immortals and Jade Immortals? They are still at the stage of sensing many rules, heavily reliant on external rules. Even a slight disturbance could affect their foundations.

“Is it because of the Ancestor of the Immortal Path? The Ancestor of the Demon Abyss? Or the Ancestor of Martial Arts?”

“I think it must be the Ancestor of Martial Arts.”

“Indeed, before the Ancestor of Martial Arts was revealed, billions of years passed without witnessing what has happened today.”

“The Ancestor of Martial Arts? Is this the doing of the Ancestor of Martial Arts?”

The many Golden and Jade Immortals were trembling with fear, not fools to have cultivated to their level, and had faintly speculated that all this might have something to do with the Ancestor of Martial Arts.

Of course.

Even so.

Not a single Golden or Jade Immortal dared to go to the Martial City to inquire with the disciples of the Ancestor of Martial Arts.

What a joke? The Ancestor of Martial Arts was able to cause a disturbance across the entire Immortal Realm, and even the Ancestor of the Immortal Path and the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss did not make any move, let alone these Golden and Jade Immortals. Going to question them would be seeking death, wasn’t it?

Did they think they had lived too long?

…

“Almost enough.”

After Lin Yuan familiarized himself with the Chaos Rule, he gradually ceased.

Lin Yuan saw the impact of the Chaos Rule on the myriad rules of the Immortal Realm; as the Origin Rule that reigns supreme above all else, the Chaos Rule naturally suppresses other rules.

Even the Space-Time Rule is no exception.

…

The core of the Origin of the Immortal Realm.

Lin Yuan’s gaze shifted, looking towards the Immortal Consciousness hiding in the corner.

A thousand years ago, when Lin Yuan entered here, he discovered the Immortal Consciousness as if facing a formidable enemy.

However, he had always been too lazy to deal with it, focusing instead on comprehending the myriad of rules here.

Seeing that Lin Yuan did not overreact, the Immortal Consciousness gradually let go of its guard and positioned itself beside Lin Yuan, dividing the core area in two.

Yet.

Ever since Lin Yuan had nurtured the Chaos Rule and actively released its Origin Rule aura, gently stimulating it to operate, the Immortal Consciousness immediately scurried like a mouse seeing a cat, without hesitation hiding in the furthest corner, trembling.

This greatly surprised Lin Yuan. Although the Immortal Consciousness could not use the power of the Immortal Realm in this core area, Lin Yuan could still feel that the Immortal Consciousness had means to protect itself.

A thousand years ago, the Immortal Consciousness compromised and let Lin Yuan in voluntarily. Besides the fact that Lin Yuan’s threat was truly effective, the Immortal Consciousness itself had other cards up its sleeve.

At least it was not completely defenseless against Lin Yuan.

“Are you afraid?”

Lin Yuan looked at the Immortal Consciousness hiding in the corner, proactively asking.

The Immortal Consciousness was only instinctive, and its reactions came from inherent fear.

“Hum hum hum…” Shortly after, the Immortal Consciousness promptly responded, clarifying Lin Yuan’s doubts.
